# AI Tool Evaluation Scorecard — Horixon

Use this in 10 minutes before you adopt any new AI tool. Score each line 1–5.

| Area | Question | Score (1–5) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Job to be done | Which painful, frequent task does it replace or speed up? | | |
| Output quality | On 5 of *your* real examples, how often is the output usable as-is? | | |
| Speed | Is it faster end to end than doing it yourself (incl. checking)? | | |
| Cost | Cost per task at your volume (not per seat). Does it scale? | | |
| Data & privacy | Where does your data go? Training opt-out? SOC 2 / DPA? | | |
| Lock-in | Can you export prompts, data and outputs? Is there an API? | | |
| Integration | Does it live where you work (Slack, IDE, browser, docs)? | | |
| Reliability | Uptime, rate limits, what happens when it is wrong? | | |
| Vendor risk | Funding, team, roadmap. Will it exist in 12 months? | | |
| Alternatives | Is a general assistant (ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini) already "good enough"? | | |

**Total: ___ / 50** — 40+ adopt · 30–39 pilot with one team · under 30 skip for now.

## 2-week pilot plan
1. Pick 1 owner and 1 workflow.
2. Baseline: time and quality today on 10 tasks.
3. Run the tool on the next 10 tasks. Measure the same things.
4. Decide: adopt / extend pilot / drop. Write down why.
